Remove `mngr tmr-behaviors`, the behavior-corpus recipe: `behavior_cli.py`, `behavior_recipe.py`, `behavior_prompts.py`, `behavior_report.py`, the `behavior_mapper.j2` and `behavior_reducer.j2` templates, the behavior report assets, and their tests. Behavior corpora are witnessed by `mngr witness` from the new `imbue-mngr-witness` package, which runs on `imbue-mngr-mapreduce` rather than on this package. `mngr tmr` is unchanged.
